title: A Geometric Expression for the Fine-Structure Constant Matching LKB to 7.6 × 10⁻¹¹
content: We present a compact, parameter-free expression for the inverse low-energy fine-structure constant, α⁻¹(0) = 4π³ + π² + π - 1/(32π⁴) + 1/(64π⁶). It evaluates to 137.035 999 216 and agrees with the 2020 LKB precision rubidium-recoil measurement to 7.6 × 10⁻¹¹ in relative terms (<1σ). The expression emerges as the static transverse electromagnetic susceptibility of the Kubo–Mori relative-entropy Hessian in a published, background-independent, finite-resolution causal-diamond framework. Its four terms correspond to the four exhaustive parts of the minimal causal diamond: the S³ × S¹ bulk history, the spin-twist bundle, the S² waist interface, and the six octahedral tip defects. Each contribution is backed by geometric analysis, operator derivation, and finite-mesh verification, relying on a single static matching assumption with no continuous fit parameters. This note isolates the result and its numerical verification for independent checking, comparison, and criticism.
